Title: Cloud backup and recovery for the Microsoft Authenticator app on Android

Body.Content:
Android users can now back up their account credentials to the cloud, and then easily and securely transfer them to a new device when needed. Once you turn cloud backup on, your data is encrypted and stored with your personal Microsoft account. Your account credentials stay updated when you add, delete, or edit your accounts.

Learn more
